buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar

proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 3.1 Registration: The Bidder should be registered with the Income Tax, Goods and Service Tax a nd Indian Coast Guard. In proof of having fully adhered to minimum eligibility criteria as mentioned above, attested c opy of PAN, GST Registration and Coast Guard registration copy shall only be acceptable. 3.2 Specification: The goods/services are to be supplied/serviced as per specification mentioned in this bid documents only. 3.3 Clearance: The Bidder should also have clearance from GSTIN, and Income Tax Department. The firm should produce valid GSTIN Certificate. 3.4 Experience: The Bidder should have at least 03 years of experience for providing services/su pplies in Indian Coast Guard/Ministries/Departments under Government of India. In proof of having fully adhered to minimum eligibility criteria as mentioned above, attested c opy of work orders along with work completion certificates/ongoing work certificates issued by the Indian Coast Guard/Ministries/Departments under Govt of India shall be acceptable. 3.5 Turnover: The Bidder should have minimum gross turnover in the similar business of providin g supply/service as per the bid document. In proof of having fully adhered to minimum eligibility criteria as mentioned above, attested c opy of the audited balance sheets (audited by Chartered Accountant) for the completed three fina ncial year i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 shall only be acceptable. 3.6 Self-Declaration: That Contractor has not been suspended or blacklisted by any Unit/ Office of Indian Coast Guard, any other PSU or Govt. Agency and submit a declaration as follows: “I/We hereby declare that I/we have not been Banned/Suspended/ Blacklisted or de- listed by any PSU/ Government Department/ Financial Institution/Court.” In case, the decl aration is found incorrect/false at any later stage, the tender is liable to be rejected, the contract s hall be closed without any further notice and Incident will be raise as per GeM Terms and Conditio ns. I/We will be disqualified in technical bid if I/we have not submitted documents as per bid requir ements or unloaded any extra documents. 3.7 Unsatisfactory Performance: The Service provider is also likely to be rejected in case of un satisfactory past performance in previous or ongoing contracts. 3.8 Firms should fill the certificates duly attached in the ATC and upload along with the other bid documents for technical evaluation. Firms falling to do so are liable for rejection. 3.9 Firms not replying to queries based on technical bids within the specified time will be rejected.

3.10 Non-submission of any of the information/documents in the format attached with this propos al shall result in disqualification. 3.11 Bidder should have proper vendor code and should submit the documents like pan card, GST IN, cancelled cheque, NEFT mandate duly certified by bank. The firm should produce ATC Certificat e as per this bid documents. 3.12 Buyer reserves all the rights to cancel the bid at any time without specifying the reasons. In t he matter of any dispute the decision of the buyer of the organisation will be final. 3.13 Paying Authority: No advance payment will be done, payment will be made post completi on of supply/work through CDA(N), Kolkata. .
